verdict.rationale: Phaser docs confirm web export plus mobile/desktop via third-party tools (Cordova/Electron-style wrappers) — 'compiled to iOS, Android, Steam and native apps using 3rd party tools' — and community reports corroborate real-world mobile app packaging (Cocoon, Cordova) and desktop performance. However, no evidence anywhere mentions console export (PlayStation/Xbox/Switch) or any console partner program, which is central to the studio-lead story. Missing for 10: documented console export path or partner program, first-party desktop packaging tooling, and independent confirmation of console shipping.
